name: Modest-IoT-Nano-Framework
description: An event-driven, asynchronous IoT framework for ESP32, built on a robust object-oriented architecture with Inversion of Control (IoC) and strict communication layer separation. Leverages thread-safe background task messaging queues driven natively by hardware timers for sophisticated, modular, and highly responsive IoT devices.
keywords: iot, esp32, freertos, event-driven, sensor, actuator, mqtt, ble
